onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Invest in business ideas or raise funds for your own project

home.title: Projects
home.emptyRaising: No projects are raising right now

project.insufficientFundsMessage: Your wallet balance is too low for this purchase. Top up your wallet to continue.
project.riskNoReason: No reason has been provided yet
project.riskReasonPlaceholder: Describe the reason for this risk rating
project.noOtherProjects: Not participating in other projects yet
project.equityToReceive: Share of the company you'll own
project.noListings: No one is selling tickets for this project yet
project.resaleBannerActive: Besides primary tickets, {{count}} are being resold by investors
project.ticketPriceHint: Price of one ticket at the current round. The price increases with each round.
project.ticketsLeftHint: How many tickets are still available to buy out of the project's total.
project.startedHint: The date this project launched and opened for investment.
project.deadlineHint: The date by which the fundraising is expected to finish.
project.roundHint: Tickets are sold in rounds: the earlier you buy, the lower the price. Each round the ticket price goes up.
project.calculatorHint: An estimate based on the quantity you entered and the project's expected return. Actual figures may differ.

finance.title: Project finance
finance.expensesCaption: Where the money went — dated entries by category
finance.reportsCaption: Monthly totals: turnover minus expenses = net profit, plus your share
finance.budgetCaption: The planned use of investor funds and progress on each item
finance.requestReleaseConfirm: Ask a moderator to release this stage's funds from the treasury?
finance.journalCaption: The month's income and expenses in one feed
finance.closeMonthCurrentWarning: This month is not over yet — you can still wait for more entries.
finance.closeMonthNote: Publishing freezes this month's entries and shows the report to investors. Dividends are paid in a separate step.
finance.confirmPayMessage: About {{amount}} will be paid to investors from your wallet. Continue?
finance.monthClosedNote: Month closed — entries are frozen by the published report
finance.deleteReasonRequired: Please explain why this entry is being deleted
finance.deleteEntryNote: The entry stays in the journal as history and won't count toward the books. Investors can see it and the reason you give.

project.equityOfferedHint: The share of the company all tickets together carry. Sold tickets earn a matching share of the profit; anything unsold stays with the founder.
project.valuationHint: What the founder is pricing the whole company at: the funding goal buys exactly the share on offer, so goal ÷ share. It's their asking price, not an independent appraisal.
project.equityPerTicketHint: Every ticket carries the same share of the company, whichever price round you buy it in — the later rounds cost more for the same slice.
project.teamEmpty: The founder has not introduced the team yet

portfolio.title: My portfolio
portfolio.noHoldings: You haven't invested in anything yet

profile.title: Profile
profile.bioPlaceholder: Who you are, what you do, why you invest
profile.shareContactsPublicly: Show Telegram and LinkedIn to other investors
profile.showFullNameHint: When off, other users see only a shortened name (e.g. G••••r K••••••n) and none of your other details — bio, job, age, gender or contacts.
profile.showFullNameFounderNote: You have a project, so your profile stays public and can't be hidden.
profile.photoRestrictions: JPG or PNG image, up to 5 MB.
profile.kycExplain: KYC (Know Your Customer) is identity verification. Investing needs no verification; getting verified is required only to create your own project. A moderator reviews and approves it.
profile.kycExplainVerified: Your identity is verified (KYC). You can create projects and show the verified badge.
profile.logoutConfirmMessage: You will need to sign in again.

wizard.aboutHint: The cover, name and description are all an investor sees in the feed.
wizard.fundingHint: The ticket price is derived from the goal, the ticket count and the rounds — it can't be typed in.
wizard.budgetHint: Where the money goes. Optional, but it raises trust a lot.
wizard.teamHint: Who is building this. Order means seniority: the first person reads as the lead.
wizard.mediaHint: Video and documents. These can be added after review too.
wizard.reviewHint: What's ready and what will block moderation. Tap a problem to jump to it.
wizard.previewHint: Exactly what an investor will see. Happy with it — send it.
wizard.previewNotice: Once sent, the project goes to moderation. You can't edit it while it's being reviewed — files and team can be added at any time.
wizard.reviewNotice: Anything marked red will block moderation. Tap a row to jump to that step.
wizard.valuationNotAvailable: Set a funding goal and a share first
wizard.equityControlWarning: You keep less than a controlling stake. And if you raise again later, a new round dilutes everyone — including you.
wizard.previewNoDescription: The description in this language is empty — an investor sees nothing here.
wizard.sumAboutOk: Name and description in every language
wizard.sumFundingBad: Goal, ticket count, rounds or company share are missing

founder.verificationRequiredMessage: You need a verified (KYC) profile to create a project. A moderator grants verification — investing itself needs no verification.
founder.budgetPlanHint: List where investors' money will go — as line items with an amount. Items already added here can't be edited or removed, only new ones added; each item's status (not started / awaiting payment / completed) is changed on the "Project finance" tab.
founder.equityOfferedHint: E.g. 49 — the share all tickets together carry
founder.equityOfferedLockedHint: Tickets have already been sold, so this share can no longer be changed
founder.equityOfferedFieldHint: How much of the company investors get if every ticket is sold. Each ticket carries an equal slice of it, so one ticket = this share ÷ ticket count. Whatever stays unsold stays yours, along with the share you didn't offer. Once the first ticket is sold this can't be changed — investors bought that exact share.
founder.impliedValuationHint: Your funding goal buys exactly the share you offered, which sets what the whole company is worth: goal ÷ share. Raising 10,000,000 for 49% prices the company at about 20,400,000. If that number looks wrong, the share is the thing to fix.
founder.reviewCommentPlaceholder: Describe the reason for this decision (approval or rejection)
founder.expectedAnnualReturnHint: E.g. 20 — investors will earn roughly 20% per year
founder.payoutStartDaysHint: E.g. 30 — payouts start accruing a month after purchase
founder.priorityFieldHint: How urgently this project or edit should be reviewed by a moderator.
founder.changeReasonPlaceholder: Explain what you changed and why (optional)
founder.changeReasonHint: An optional note for the moderator — helps explain the reason and context behind the edit.
founder.editPendingNotice: Your changes were submitted for review. Editing will be available again once the moderator approves or rejects them.
founder.reviewPendingNotice: This project is pending review. Editing will be available once the moderator makes a decision.
founder.deleteConfirmMessage: You'll be able to undo this within 7 days.
founder.deleteConfirmMessageWithInvestors: This project has investors, so a moderator must approve the deletion first. Once approved, you'll be able to undo it within 7 days.
founder.deletedRestorableNotice: Project deleted. {{days}} day(s) left to restore it.
founder.deletionPendingNotice: Deletion request sent to the moderator.
founder.deletionRequestMessage: This project has {{investors}} investor(s) and {{tickets}} tickets sold. Confirm if you agree to delete it.
founder.missingLanguagesError: Fill in the title and description in every language: {{languages}}
founder.deadlineInvalidError: Enter a future date in YYYY-MM-DD format
founder.priceTierCountRangeError: Number of rounds must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
founder.formHasErrorsNotice: Some fields are missing or invalid — check the form above
founder.titleFieldHint: A short, clear project name. It's the first thing investors see in the project list.
founder.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the business, why you need the funds, and how they'll be used
founder.descriptionFieldHint: Explain what the business does, what the raised money will be used for, and why it's worth investing in.
founder.categoryFieldHint: A short business category — helps investors browse the project list.
founder.targetAmountHint: The total amount to raise. Should roughly match the total value of all tickets across all price rounds (see the preview below).
founder.ticketPriceAutoHint: The ticket price is calculated automatically as: funding goal ÷ (ticket count, weighted for the price increase across rounds). This guarantees the numbers always add up.
founder.ticketPriceNotAvailable: Fill in "Funding goal" and "Number of tickets" to see the price
founder.totalTicketsHint: How many tickets will be sold in total over the whole raise — split evenly across the price rounds.
founder.deadlineFieldHint: The date by which the fundraising is expected to finish. Optional — you can leave it blank.
founder.priceTierCountFieldHint: How many rounds to split ticket sales into (1 to 10). Each round the ticket price goes up by the percentage set below.
founder.priceTierIncrementPercentHint: How many percent the ticket price goes up each following round. Defaults to 20%.
founder.youtubeUrlFieldHint: Paste a link to a YouTube video about the project — it will be embedded on the project page.
founder.youtubeUrlInvalidError: That doesn't look like a YouTube link. Copy it from the address bar or the "Share" button.
founder.attachmentsHint: Attach a business plan, financial calculations, and other documents that help investors decide.
founder.attachmentsWebOnlyNotice: Attaching files is currently only available in the web app.
founder.projectSubmittedNotice: Project submitted for moderation. Attach files below, then press "Close". Changes to the other fields above won't be saved.
founder.attachmentsRules: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or images (JPG, PNG) · up to 20 MB per file · up to {{count}} files, you can select several at once
founder.attachmentsLimitReached: File limit reached. Remove one of the attached files to add a new one.
founder.expectedAnnualReturnFieldHint: The expected annual return investors will earn on the amount they invest, e.g. 20%.
founder.payoutStartDaysFieldHint: How many days after buying a ticket an investor starts earning payouts.
founder.resaleEnabledFieldHint: If enabled, investors can resell their tickets to other investors right within the platform.
founder.teamHint: Say who is building this. Investors back people as much as ideas.
founder.teamBioPlaceholder: Experience, what they own in the project
founder.teamRemoveConfirm: Remove this member from the team?
founder.teamMemberIncomplete: Fill in name and role, or this member will not be saved

works.title: Works
works.caption: One-off paid tasks the project needs — apply and get paid from the project treasury.
works.premiumHint: Extra % the worker gets if paid in tickets instead of cash.
works.howPaid: How do you want to be paid?
works.paymentExplainHint: "Cash" — a regular money payment. "Tickets" — paid in the project's shares (tickets) instead of money, sometimes with a bonus %.
works.contactsHiddenNote: ⚠ Your contacts are hidden by your privacy settings — the employer won't see them on your profile. Be sure to write in your cover letter how to reach you (e.g. Telegram or WhatsApp).
works.contactsVisibleNote: The employer will be able to see your contacts on your profile.
works.coverLetterPlaceholder: Why you're the right pick: experience, sample work, timeline. How to reach you — e.g. Telegram @username or WhatsApp.
works.coverLetterHint: Explain why to choose you and leave a contact (Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.).
works.disputeConfirm: Open a dispute for a moderator to resolve?
works.selectNoFunds: This stage's funds haven't been released yet. Request a release in the Plan tab and wait for moderator approval, then pick a worker.
works.selectAmountHint: Defaults to the worker's price. You can set the actually-agreed amount.

refund.confirmMessage: Mark this project failed and refund the frozen treasury to ticket holders in proportion to tickets held. This cannot be undone.

users.title: Users
users.deleteConfirmMessage: The user will lose access to the platform. Financial history is kept and the profile can be restored.
users.kycHint: Set to "Verified" to let this user create projects. This is the only place verification is granted.
